pages.title: A Hearty Meal
pages.text: Once simple snacks are no longer enough, craft a Pooburger, Poop Soup, Poop Pasta, or Poodding.$(br2)These foods restore more hunger and are great before exploring or fighting.

pages.title: Festive and Advanced
pages.text: Poop Mooncakes, Chili Poop Mooncakes, and Golden Poop Mooncakes are more distinctive filth foods.$(br2)They usually require more ingredients but provide better benefits.
